name: icpac-geonode-somalia-regions-hit-by-1984-tropical-cyclone-04b
notes:
1984 Tropical Cyclone 04B was a weak storm that struck eastern Somalia in Mudug province, and quickly dissipated. The storm had a maximunm windspeed of 18m/s before dessipating.

The cyclone was detected on 23/11/1984. Mudug landfall was on 7/12/1984. There were no reports of damages or injuries from this storm.

organization.name: igad-climate-prediction-and-application-center
organization.title: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
organization.description: ICPAC is a Climate Center accredited by the World Meteorological Organization that provides Climate Services to 11 East African Countries. Our services aim at creating resilience in a region deeply affected by climate change and extreme weather.
